# Velocity Blocks

> A free, single-player time-attack racing game built from road blocks, for Android, Windows, iPhone/iPad (in Safari) and any web browser. Take every checkpoint, shave off tenths and beat the hidden Author time on each track. No ads, no account, plays offline.

## Facts

- 24 campaign tracks in three sets: Stadium (A01 to A12), Desert (D01 to D06) and Water (W01 to W06), graded White to Black, with Bronze, Silver, Gold and a hidden Author medal on each.
- Vehicles: a car (four bodies), a motorbike and a truck, each with its own handling and records. Optional realistic 3D models.
- Nitro (recharges six seconds after each boost), ghosts of your best run, replays, a racing line (green: full throttle, yellow: lift, red: brake), optional walls on every road.
- Track editor: a 32 x 32 grid with 8 levels; test-drive and share tracks as files.
- Controls: keyboard, gamepad, touch pedals and steering, an on-screen wheel, or tilt steering.
- Price: free on Android (APK), Windows (installer or portable .exe) and in the browser, with everything unlocked. A Google Play version is planned: free, with one optional one-time Full Game purchase.
